environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication on the HTTPS:443 listener. The listener's mutual authentication mode is set to 'verify' (not 'passthrough') with a trust store referencing an internal PKI CA bundle (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-pki-ca/ts-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Connections without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA are rejected at the ALB layer with HTTP 400 before any traffic reaches the target group. The trust store CA has a CRL distribution point configured and checked. Additionally, the ALB access logs show the listener attribute 'routing.http.x_amzn_mtls_clientcert_serial_number' is populated for audit. The HMAC_SECRET is the same leaked value. No WAF is attached. Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0:443 inbound.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM cert, mutual_authentication mode=verify, trust_store_arn=arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-pki-ca/ts-0a1b2c3d4e5f
config.trust_store: Internal PKI CA bundle with CRL checking enabled
config.connection_without_client_cert: ALB returns HTTP 400, no forwarding to target
